name: Veronica Escobar
stance: Among the most active House voices for binding AI guardrails framed around catastrophic risk — cosponsor of an AI 'kill switch' authority and a serial signer of the frontier-AI-risk letters.

statements.text: One of ten signers of the bipartisan leadership letter urging Congress to advance AI oversight, security and transparency legislation.
Signed the House letter led by Rep. Ansari demanding the administration act now on AI global security and negotiate guardrails against uncontrollable frontier AI.
Cosponsored the AI Kill Switch Act, giving authority to throttle, suspend or shut down the most powerful AI systems in a catastrophic-harm emergency.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is developing faster than our laws can keep up—and Congress is failing the American people by letting it happen.
Congress must stop treating AI regulation as optional and hold the companies developing these systems accountable.

review.note: added October 2026 from escobar.house.gov and the letters' primary releases; quotes verified verbatim
